ValidationRule.description: Enforce requirement for either the home phone or cell phone field to be filled out when completing forms through Docusign.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISBLANK( HomePhone ) && ISBLANK( MobilePhone ) && ISBLANK( Email ) && $User.Id != '005G00000049DTx' /*Mark McCarthy, for data loads)*/
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter either a home phone number or a cell phone number or an email address.
